summary: Frontend-only test of 3 new FitForge features: StreakFlame, BarcodeScanner (Open Food Facts), SleepWeightChart. All features work as specified. PIN login (858608) succeeded, dashboard loaded to Today tab. StreakFlame widget renders with 0-day streak showing 'START TODAY' (uppercased via CSS). Scan button visible; opens BarcodeScanner modal with 'Open Food Facts' badge, manual barcode input, and Look up button. Entering barcode 3017624010701 correctly fetched 'Nutella' by 'Ferrero' from Open Food Facts (per 100g: 539 cal, 57.5g C, 6.3g P, 30.9g F). Servings +/- controls update servings display (1 -> 1.25 -> 0.75). Rescan resets modal to scanning phase. 'Add to today' successfully logged nutrition (SCORE increased 16 -> 22 confirming persistence). Trends tab shows Sleep vs Weight chart with 'Last 30 days' badge and 'No sleep data yet' empty state as expected. No React errors in console.
critical_code_review_comments: BarcodeScanner: rescan() and initial useEffect duplicate ~15 lines of Html5Qrcode init logic — extract to helper for DRY.

BarcodeScanner: handleLog error branch sets error but leaves modal state as 'found' with error message never rendered (no

for error in found phase). Consider showing inline error under Add to today button.
SleepWeightChart: axios call has no cancellation on unmount; small race condition if user switches tabs quickly (not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features validated. StreakFlame data-testid=streak-flame; Scan button data-testid=scan-btn; barcode-modal, barcode-manual-input, barcode-manual-lookup, barcode-servings, barcode-serving-plus/minus, barcode-rescan, barcode-log, sleep-weight-chart all wired. Real OFF API call works with barcode 3017624010701 (Nutella).
